exceptions.classification: Affected development dependency; application does not execute Node.
exceptions.decision: Temporary tooling exception. The vendor attack requires attacker-controlled glob patterns with optimizationLevel >= 2. Lint patterns are repository-controlled; ReFind HTTP requests do not reach this package. ESLint 10.14.0 still requires minimatch ^10.2.6, so do not force minimatch 11 across an incompatible parent range. Review a compatible upstream fix or isolate/replace tooling after tests; bound CI execution time.
